text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash informs us that "Leckermaul" is the name of the bad witch that appears in the German fairy tale, Hansel and Gretel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe is racked with anxiety over the possibility of her guiding friend being a malevolent witch…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Concerned about Manhattan Cafe, Zenno Rob Roy tells us that good witches also exist.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We learn that Zenno Rob Roy intends to enter the Japan Cup. Manhattan Cafe's friend has put us on a collision course with another rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But what will Manhattan Cafe learn from her race with Zenno Rob Roy?
